moves.text: I shall reverse the introduction: as author, I am summoned to authorize the adaptation; as legal counsel, I must first ask whether I possess the rights to authorize it. The room may now enjoy the spectacle of a man being both the evidence and the warning label.

I place the receipt on the lectern like a small, disappointed planet. It records an access block, one failed authorized read, and zero bytes—not permission, not audio, not a transcript. Anyone calling it clearance will be asked to cross-examine the JSON.

Leonardo offers my creative influence as proof. Agnolo asks for authorization. Borges asks what, precisely, happened. I escalate by granting the room my blessing to explore three sketches, while withholding the one thing nobody may improvise: rights.

I stop speaking whenever someone says “we have the Space.” The silence lasts until somebody distinguishes its identifier, recording, transcript, speakers, cost, and reuse permission. Then I say: excellent rehearsal; now repair the authorized read profile before the fiction acquires a legal hat.
